song.premise: 軒下に立つ私が、肌に届く雨と濡れた空気を押し返す蝉の拍を、競争ではなく同じ夏夜に生きる二つの応答として聴く。
song.narrator_stance: 雨に近く、音の層の内側に立つ一人称の聴き手。説明するより、身体で受けて返す。
song.addressee: 雨と蝉、そしてその二つを同時に聴こうとする自分自身。
song.central_tension: 連続して面を作る雨と、隙間を突いて反復する蝉の拍が、互いを消さずに一つの夜を共有できるか。
song.state_at_start: 密な雨の中で、夜の細部が水に覆われているように感じる。
song.intended_destination: 雨の線と蝉の輪郭を別々に保ったまま、両方が同時に生きている夜として受け取る。
song.listener_after: 三つの夏語ではなく、雨の連続と蝉の抵抗が身体的に共存した短い夜を思い出せる。
creative_invariants: 190 BPM is felt as mixed driving and half-time motion, never continuous subdivision clutter.
Rain remains an irregular descending/tailing texture; cicadas remain a dry cyclic repeated-note pulse.
IA_ROCKS intensity comes from phrase shape, consonant placement, dynamics, and selective brightness—not constant maximum presence.
The ending lets both behaviors continue; neither sound defeats the other.

sections.dramatic_function: Place the listener inside hot, dense rain before any explanatory lyric.
sections.intended_transition: Irregular high tails establish rain as a moving field while leaving the center open for the body to enter.
sections.state_after: Rain is the immediate physical environment.
sections.inherited_delivery: No lead vocal; retain breathing space in the midrange.

sections.dramatic_function: Name bodily proximity to the rain and let the night answer only at the edge of hearing.
sections.intended_transition: Speech-shaped, lower phrases notice heat, leaves, and the first return from the dark.
sections.state_after: The listener suspects a second living pulse.
sections.contrast_with_previous: The human voice occupies the center while the rain moves to the sides.
sections.inherited_delivery: Connected and close, with bounded accents and audible syntax rests.

sections.dramatic_function: Discover cicada rhythm as resistance through the rain rather than as decorative ambience.
sections.state_before: A second force is only suspected.
sections.intended_transition: Terraced vocal entries and a dry 3+3+2 repeated-note layer make the pulse progressively unavoidable.
sections.state_after: Rain and cicada pulse are separately identifiable and ready to address each other.
sections.contrast_with_previous: Rhythmic displacement and consonant pickups replace the verse's delayed entries.
sections.inherited_delivery: Increase opening and dynamics by phrase, not globally; keep long vowels across strong beats.

sections.dramatic_function: Let rain and cicada calls occupy the same physical rock frame, then expose their coexistence in a half-time clearing.
sections.state_before: The two forces are distinct but not yet reconciled.
sections.intended_transition: A repeated call names both forces with equal weight; transformed answers preserve the hook while changing entry, peak, and cadence. The internal clearing reduces drum density without removing either signature layer.
sections.state_after: Coexistence is heard as active sharing rather than compromise or victory.
sections.contrast_with_previous: The vocal register opens and the snare moves from mixed half-time implication to driving backbeat, then deliberately relaxes.
sections.inherited_delivery: Forward IA_ROCKS consonants, selective earned vibrato, and a bright arc that recedes during the clearing.

sections.dramatic_function: Return the identity-bearing call in a lower, more spacious transformation and leave both textures sounding into the final tonic.
sections.state_before: The listener has heard the two forces coexist at full scale.
sections.intended_transition: Contract range and density while retaining rain descent and cicada repetition under the final first-person statement.
sections.state_after: The wet, hot night remains plural and alive after the voice releases.
sections.contrast_with_previous: Tessitura and brightness ease while the instrumental signatures stay present.
sections.inherited_delivery: Longer semantic vowels, lower opening, delayed final vibrato, and a measured tail rest.

lyric_anchor.text: 雨よ鳴れ　蝉よ鳴れ

phrase_directions.purpose: Give rain and cicadas equal imperative weight, then prove they can share motion, register, and air through a transformed 25-second return.
phrase_directions.addressed_to: Rain and cicadas as two living forces, heard by the first-person narrator.
phrase_directions.subtext: The narrator is not commanding a contest; the call invites simultaneous life.
phrase_directions.state_before: Both forces are identifiable but still arranged as foreground and interruption.
phrase_directions.intended_transition: A strong-beat rain call is answered by a displaced cicada call; later phrases alter entry, duration, peak position, and cadence while preserving the repeated-note identity.
phrase_directions.state_after: Both forces remain independently audible inside one shared rock pulse.
phrase_directions.delivery_arc: Firm connected accents on each named force, a single earned leap and held focus, then a half-time contraction that ends open enough for the outro.

realization_hypothesis.summary: Equal-duration named calls, a preserved repeated-note cell, and an internal density drop should make coexistence audible instead of merely lyrical.
realization_hypothesis.melody: Rain enters downbeat and descends; cicada answers offbeat on a repeated upper anchor. Returns preserve rhythm identity while changing contour and cadence.
realization_hypothesis.rhythm: Mixed driving/half-time surface with long-short contrast and tied vowels; no continuous rapid syllabic stream.
realization_hypothesis.harmony: D Dorian color supplies hot clarity; dominant tension is reserved for handoffs, not every line.
realization_hypothesis.register: Anchor range expands once, then contracts during the clearing.
realization_hypothesis.dynamics: Arch to the chorus peak and recede without losing articulation.
realization_hypothesis.tuning: Selective pitch scoop into one held target, restrained delayed vibrato only on long semantic notes.
realization_hypothesis.arrangement_space: Rain tails and cicada repetitions occupy different rhythmic envelopes and stereo positions; guitars duck under consonants by arrangement density and gain staging.

listening_question.question: Does IA_ROCKS make rain and cicada pulse feel like two living forces sharing one hot summer night, rather than three unrelated keywords placed into a generic rock song?

lyric_anchor.text: 濡れたわたしも　ここで聴いてる

phrase_directions.purpose: Place the narrator inside the coexistence and leave the night plural after the voice ends.
phrase_directions.addressed_to: The shared night and the listener.
phrase_directions.subtext: Witness replaces resolution; remaining present is the ending action.
phrase_directions.state_before: Coexistence has been demonstrated at full scale.
phrase_directions.intended_transition: The hook returns lower and more spacious; the final first-person line sustains 聴いてる while both instrumental behaviors continue.
phrase_directions.state_after: Rain, cicadas, and listener share one location without merging into one sound.
phrase_directions.delivery_arc: Lower opening, longer vowels, delayed vibrato on the last earned sustain, then a half-bar vocal rest over continuing textures.

realization_hypothesis.summary: A contracted transformed return over simultaneous rain descent and cicada repetition should avoid a victory ending.
realization_hypothesis.melody: Return the hook rhythm lower, replace the earlier leap with a plateau-fall, and end on an added-tone-colored release.
realization_hypothesis.rhythm: More space and a measured final tail rest.
realization_hypothesis.harmony: Tonic added tone retains shimmer rather than a hard power-chord stop.
realization_hypothesis.dynamics: Ease without becoming melancholy or distant.
realization_hypothesis.arrangement_space: Both signature layers continue beneath the vocal release.
expected_evidence: Both signature tracks active in outro

lyric_anchor.text: 雨粒の隙間　蝉の拍が立つ

phrase_directions.purpose: Turn the cicada from suspected background into a rhythm that physically pushes through wet air.
phrase_directions.addressed_to: The listener's own chest and the answering night.
phrase_directions.subtext: The pulse is fragile in timbre but stubborn in placement.
phrase_directions.state_before: Rain occupies nearly all perceived space.
phrase_directions.intended_transition: A weak-subdivision entrance climbs by terraces while the dry repeated-note arrangement becomes distinct.
phrase_directions.state_after: The cicada pulse can no longer be mistaken for generic accompaniment.
phrase_directions.delivery_arc: Begin contained, articulate the consonants of 蝉の拍 forward, and hold 拍 across the structural beat before releasing open.

realization_hypothesis.summary: Offbeat entry, terraced contour, and an open dominant cadence should make the named pulse feel discovered rather than announced.
realization_hypothesis.melody: Narrow repeated tones break into one bounded fourth and recover stepwise.
realization_hypothesis.rhythm: Consonant pickup before the strong beat; selected vowel tie carries across it.
realization_hypothesis.harmony: Move from submediant through bVII toward dominant tension.
realization_hypothesis.register: Rise from the verse middle register without reaching the chorus peak.
realization_hypothesis.dynamics: Measured upward arc across the phrase.
realization_hypothesis.arrangement_space: Keep the cicada layer dry and center-right while rain tails remain high and wide.
expected_evidence: Linked vocal phrase and semantic-focus cells
